sloka: कच्चित् ते सुभृता भृत्याः कच्चित् तिष्ठन्ति शासने ।कच्चित् ते विजिताः सर्वे रिपवो रिपु सूदन ॥१-५२-८॥
transliteration: kaccit te subhṛtā bhṛtyāḥ kaccit tiṣṭhanti śāsane ।kaccit te vijitāḥ sarve ripavo ripu sūdana ॥1-52-8॥

translations.english: Are your servants provided well with their requirements? Do they abide by your command? O Destroyer of foes have all your enemies been conquered ?
